# Enova Team Members Help Local Students Get Ready for School


September 8, 2026


Every summer, Enova employees across the country come together to pack backpacks and school supply kits for children in their local communities. This year,


**421 team members** in Chicago, Denver, New York City and South Jordan came together to prepare students for a successful school year, assembling a combined


**3,500** backpacks and supply kits, and contributing


**152** volunteer hours in the process.


Each Enova office partners with a local nonprofit focused on educational equity: Cradles to Crayons in Chicago, Granite Education Foundation in South Jordan, Part of the Solution (POTS) in New York and Kenzi’s Causes in Denver. These partnerships extend well beyond a single event; they were selected because they reflect Enova’s ongoing commitment to the communities where our employees live and work.


The back-to-school packing event has become one of the most anticipated events on Enova’s calendar, and this year’s turnout was no different. Team members from departments across the company sorted supplies, assembled kits and packed backpacks for students who will carry them into a new school year.


At Enova, giving back is part of how the company operates every day. Our Enova Gives program partners with organizations across the country to expand access to financial education and essential resources, and it gives team members several ways to contribute, including donation matching, corporate volunteer opportunities and dedicated volunteer days for the nonprofit of their choice.
